dsh-themes is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-af828e7fe8ddd8df6942.html
